segments.contract: entry → negative states → chained transitions → persistence/loop diagnostics

logical input → attack/contact → damage/stat scaling/life adjustments/runtime fallback/recovery/reset → held/projectile/helper guard/release → jump/air-jump budget/landing/reset → sweep/legacy bounce/recovery
helper creation → self binding/Pause/body contact → retirement/orphan effects → hit-paused throw/recovery → borrowed-state effect/Pause/SelfState/expiry → round identity reset
title/selection → rendered VS → stock input-driven fight → KO/time-over → results → rematch/exit

presentation_followups: Known indexed sprite/shadow alignment and finite/overlap RGB differences are corrected. Native fixed 3/8 calibration replaces the old half-pixel plus source-grid approximation; byte interpolation rounds the weighted delta before adding the first texel. One bounded scene and the connected stage lifecycle retain exact native RGB expectations. OnTop effects blend over HUD before final AllPalFX.

Ordinary KO-echo gap is closed for the existing acceptance: both current native and Go device captures yield all seven segments and three native cue levels, including the quiet interval. The historical mismatch no longer reproduces on the current mixer/decoder; preserve the scheduler and original tolerances. Sample-exact device synchronization remains unverified.
Turns, mixed-team and Survival recovery are calibrated against bounded beta flows. AI command selection is functional; native decision probabilities remain unverified.

Bounded camera/body-push/binding lifecycles are covered. Moving zoom now matches eleven sampled beta points through the return; the former0.15-pixel error is fixed by preserving the unclipped midpoint. Other pause/hitpause, binding and crop/raster precision remain unverified. Projectile contacts intentionally do not recoil the owner.

RGBA mask views, byte-truncated uploads and linear true-color background filtering match 40 fixed samples in one beta/Linux scene. This does not establish whole-frame or arbitrary alpha/palette/filtering parity.

Authored low-resolution grids and offscreen cells are content layout choices. Mixed-coordinate portraits, versus presentation and optional recovery constants are implemented. Later-round stalls reproduced by the target runtime are content defects; no further third-party script repairs are planned.

Arbitrary air cancels, turning during bindings/hitpause and charge-history permutations remain unverified; do not treat Paintown C++ turning as the reference.

Command time is at least one tick and buffer time is limited to 1–30. Full character loading rejects empty command sets with the CMD path and DEF context, and corrected content reloads. Existing human/helper/long-charge AI and asset/ZIP/reload scenarios cover these consumers. Four affected segments pass with races; state-flow stays checked. Rebuilt Linux matches native command-window counts 5/30/1. Diagnostic overlay/capture removed; shared assets reused.

known_differences.name: State entry and persistence first-value precedence
known_differences.validation: Statedef attributes retain the first authored value in both raw entry parameters and parsed metadata. Repeated persistent attributes also retain the first value; repeated trigger lines remain separate conditions. The existing animation/runtime combat lifecycle continues through duplicate type/movetype/physics/control/animation/velocity/power settings, one-shot persistence, contradictory triggers and own-state recovery. All five segments pass with races. Rebuilt Linux matches all twelve native entry/motion/persistence observations. Diagnostic overlay/capture removed; shared assets reused.

known_differences.name: Scalar control/effect fallback and minimum life adjustments
known_differences.validation: PlayerPush, AttackDist, PosFreeze, HitAdd, VictoryQuote, attack/defence multipliers and RemoveExplod accept ordinary-bottom zero fallback while true VM failures retain their checks. Nonzero negative nonabsolute LifeAdd/TargetLifeAdd retain a one-point minimum after defence scaling; explicit zero stays zero, and zero attack can still produce a zero-damage contact. The existing runtime combat lifecycle spans guard-range change, freeze release, selective effect removal, stat adjustment, real contact, life changes, both actors recovering and effect retirement. All five segments pass with races. Rebuilt Linux matches all twelve native observations. Diagnostic overlay/capture/helper removed; shared assets reused.

known_differences.name: Target numeric fallback after relationship and ID admission
known_differences.validation: The mixed-coordinate entity lifecycle now spans unmatched bottom IDs (skipping side effects and unused VM failures), matched numeric fallback for life/power/velocity/facing/state, target retention/drop and own-state recovery followed by round reset. All twelve native observations match rebuilt Linux; all five connected segments pass with race detection. Ordinary bottom becomes zero only after relationship/ID admission; admitted real VM failures remain fatal. Owned overlay and captures removed.

known_differences.name: Protection, sound and palette fallback through contact recovery
known_differences.validation: HitBy/NotHitBy timers and HitOverride state/slot/time/forceair accept ordinary-bottom zero fallback; the connected mixed-coordinate fight clears active protection/override, takes a normal ten-point contact and recovers both actors. PlaySnd/SndPan/StopSnd and RemapPal likewise retain later argument evaluation after ordinary bottom; omitted defaults stay intact. Real VM errors remain fatal before application, including deprecated volume. All twelve native observations match rebuilt Linux. All five changed-source segments pass with races; owned overlay/captures removed. Override range admission is covered by the following checkpoint.

known_differences.name: HitOverride slot admission, clearing and reaction recovery
known_differences.validation: Out-of-range positive/negative HitOverride slots select slot zero rather than aborting or clamping to slot seven. Durations below -1 clear that slot; -1 remains indefinite. A shared normalization consumer keeps compiled controllers and direct character adapters consistent. The existing mixed-coordinate combat flow continues through four contacts: override reaction, explicit clearing/normal reaction, another invalid-slot override, invalid-duration clearing/normal reaction and own-state/control recovery, with all overrides retired. All twelve native observations match rebuilt Linux. All five changed-source segments pass with races; owned scratch removed.

known_differences.name: Nested VM failures stop evaluation before partial writes
known_differences.validation: A fatal error in a redirect ID retains its runtime error through coercion rather than becoming ordinary bottom. Fatal assignment indices and interval lower bounds stop before evaluating later expressions. Ordinary bottom and valid eager evaluation retain their policies. The existing runtime recovery scenario includes terminal branches covering parameters and trigger conditions, source-context errors, unchanged position/velocity and suppressed later assignment side effects. All five changed-source segments pass with race detection. This closes the source-audited error propagation paths; it does not claim arbitrary expression conformance.

Affected match-flow passes with races; other completed segments stay checked. Linux rebuilt and visually inspected. Omitted windows remain unmasked; authored scene windows still carry forward and clip BGs. Arbitrary source-aspect/common-resolution/filtering parity is not established. Owned scratch removed.
